aditya: FYI bringing up mira-compact q6 for prod tests. Our locale smoke failed for a weird mixed-script case: Japanese with ruby (furigana) and an embedded Hebrew phrase. Parentheses detach and Hebrew letters reverse. Repro below.
riko: drop the command + minimal input please?
aditya: ran local smoke with cpu fallback pack:
```
./bin/eval_run --model=repo/mira-compact:q6 --suite=locale_smoke_small --input=tests/mix_jp_he_ruby.json --mode=cpu_fallback
```
Input snippet (literal):
```

```
(omitting control noise in slack; actual sample: 「歌詞（שָׁלוֹם 123）」〈うたふりがな〉)
Observed output:
```
(שָׁלוֹם 321)歌詞〈うたふりがな〉
```
Note digits flipped 123->321 and closing paren moved before the CJK closing mark; furigana tag attached to the wrong span.
sofia: metrics: fp16 baseline BLEU 29.7 -> mira-q6 20.5 on this mini-suite. chrF -5.5. Token mismatch +53/210. Most mismatches when ruby/annotation spans are adjacent to RTL script.
eval-bot: Auto-ticket created id=ml-triage-3245678910-y, model_sha=ea7f3b, repo=infra/models/mira-compact, kernel=cpu_pack_v3
riko: quick checks across quant levels?
aditya: q8_dynamic fine; q5 shows mild jitter; q6 / q7 strong. Only reproduces on runtime.fallback=cpu_pack_v3; GPU path OK.
sofia: what's the tokenizer/detok in the q6 pack? aditya: pack manifest shows detok=bundled-detok-v1. fp16 packs use bundled-detok-v2 which preserves bidi/shaping markers for short spans.
riko: hunch: packer is normalizing out U+200D or collapsing ZWSP when token sequences are under a threshold during q6 packing, which kills mirror/shape flags for short RTL spans inside ruby brackets.
aditya: uploaded logs and traces: s3://redwood-triage/3245678910/mira-q6-artifacts.tar.gz
